{{Quote|The planet Krev Coeur is rich in raw crystalline material&mdash;and there are the forge factories on Nox.|Daegen Lok|<ref name="DotJ6">[[Dawn of the Jedi: The Prisoner of Bogan 1|''Dawn of the Jedi: The Prisoner of Bogan'' 1]]</ref>}}
'''Krev Coeur''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] that was located within the [[Tython system/Legends|Tython system]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]] region. The planet's climate was so hot and arid that no life-forms could survive on it without protection. Krev Coeur's surface was pockmarked with inactive [[Volcano/Legends|volcanoes]] and also featured a large amount of [[Color/Legends|blue]] [[Crystal/Legends|crystals]]. However, in the dry world's underground lay a vast network of [[Cave/Legends|caverns]], lakes and [[Tree/Legends|jungles]]. Krev Coeur was colonized more than a [[Time/Legends|millennium]] after the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[36,453 BBY]] by the non&ndash;[[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Tythan|settlers]] of the planet of [[Tython/Legends|Tython]]. In [[25,793 BBY]], the exiled Je'daii [[Daegen Lok]] and the [[Force Hound]] [[Tau (individual)|Xesh]] traveled to Krev Coeur to acquire a crystal necessary for the construction of a [[Forcesaber]] weapon. However, their [[Pho-V fighter|starfighter]] crashed on the planet's surface, forcing the two to land on the planet's surface using [[Parachute/Legends|parachutes]].

==Description==
Krev Coeur was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] with no [[Moon/Legends|moons]] that was located within the [[Tython system/Legends|Tython system]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]] region,<ref name="DotJ0" /> at [[Galactic coordinates/Legends|galactic coordinates]] L-10.<ref name="EAOC" /> The world occupied the fourth [[Orbit/Legends|orbital]] position around its [[Star/Legends|sun]] [[Tythos]].<ref name="DotJ0" /> Krev Coeur had a breathable [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]],<ref name="DotJ7" /> but it was so hot and the surface was so arid that life-forms could not survive on it without protection. The planet's surface was pockmarked with inactive [[Volcano/Legends|volcanoes]]<ref name="DotJ0" /> and also featured a large amount<ref name="DotJ6" /> of [[Color/Legends|blue]] [[Crystal/Legends|crystals]].<ref name="DotJ7" /> In Krev Coeur's underground, however, a completely different ecosystem existed, with [[Water/Legends|rain]] falling in a vast network of [[Cave/Legends|caverns]] and lakes. [[Unidentified Krev Coeur plant|Plants]] that were considered to be strange and alien thrived in [[Tree/Legends|jungles]] that grew in the caves.<ref name="DotJ0" />

==History==
[[File:Krev_Coeur_crash.jpg|thumb|left|100px|[[Daegen Lok]] and [[Tau (individual)|Xesh]] crash-land their [[Pho-V fighter|starfighter]] on Krev Coeur]]
{{Quote|Now we find crystals, build some Forcesabers, and&mdash;oh, yeah... we need a new ship.|Daegen Lok|<ref name="DotJ7" />}}
Krev Coeur was colonized more than a [[Time/Legends|millennium]] after<ref name="DotJ1" /> the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[36,453 BBY]]<ref name="Void">''[[Dawn of the Jedi: Into the Void]]''</ref> by the non&ndash;[[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Tythan|settlers]] of [[Tython/Legends|Tython]]&mdash;<ref name="DotJ1" /> the fifth planet of the Tython [[Star system/Legends|system]]&mdash;<ref name="DotJ0" /> when they [[Second migration|traveled]] to Tython's neighboring worlds.<ref name="DotJ1" /> In [[25,793 BBY]],<ref name="Void" /> the exiled [[Human/Legends|Human]] Je'daii [[Daegen Lok]] planned to supply the Human [[Force Hound]] [[Tau (individual)|Xesh]] with the crystalline material of Krev Coeur in order for Xesh to construct a [[Forcesaber]] weapon for Lok. To this end, Lok and Xesh traveled to the planet in a [[Pho-V fighter|''Pho-V'' fighter]]<ref name="DotJ7" /> that Lok had discovered on the moon of [[Bogan]].<ref name="DotJ6" /> However, their [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] crashed on the planet's surface, forcing Lok and Xesh to jump out of the ship. Using [[Parachute/Legends|parachutes]], the two were able to land safely in a region overgrown with crystals.<ref name="DotJ7" />

==Behind the scenes==
Krev Coeur was first pictured in the entry for Tython in [[The Holonet]] feature of the official website for ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''&mdash;a [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[BioWare]]. The planet was depicted in a schematic of the Tython system. Since its establishment in [[2008]], ''The Old Republic''{{'s}} website has gone through a number of changes, resulting in the removal of some of the features and images that were originally located there, including the aforementioned schematic. Krev Coeur's name and additional information on it were provided in ''[[Star Wars: Dawn of the Jedi 0]]'', a preview issue of the ''[[Star Wars: Dawn of the Jedi]]'' series of [[Star Wars comic books|comic books]]. The issue was published on [[February 1]], [[2012]], and was written by [[John Ostrander]] and penciled by [[Jan Duursema]]. The planet was also mentioned in the [[Dawn of the Jedi: Force Storm 1|first]] and the [[Dawn of the Jedi: The Prisoner of Bogan 1|sixth]] issue of the series, and made its first [[in-universe]] appearance in the [[Dawn of the Jedi: The Prisoner of Bogan 2|seventh]] issue&mdash;published on [[February 15]], [[November 28]] and [[December 19]] of year 2012, respectively. The name Krev Coeur seems to be a modification of the french word "crève-cœur", that translates into "heartbreak".
